payload.goal: Add expense categories to the splitter. Extend the Expense type with an optional category field validated against a fixed set of categories, add computeCategoryTotals to the domain, expose listCategoryTotals from the API layer, render a category breakdown in the web surface, and cover the new behaviour with tests. Preserve the existing balance behaviour and keep the current tests green.

breakdown.objective: Add optional fixed-set expense categories, compute and expose category totals, render a category breakdown, and keep existing balance behavior covered and green.

acceptanceIntents.description: Expense supports an optional category field that is accepted only when it belongs to the fixed category set.
Domain code computes totals grouped by category without regressing existing balance computation.
API layer exposes listCategoryTotals backed by the domain category-total computation.
Web summary renders a category breakdown while preserving current balance output.
New behavior is covered by tests and the existing test and typecheck suites remain green.

root.title: Expense Categories
root.objective: Add fixed-category support across domain, API, web summary, and tests while preserving existing balance behavior.
expectedOutcomes: Expenses can optionally carry a validated fixed-set category.
Category totals are computed in the domain and exposed through the API.
The web summary includes a category breakdown.
Existing balance behavior remains unchanged and covered.

cut.rationale: The change crosses the existing domain, API, web, and test files, but it is a small vertical feature with no new persistence or external dependency surface.

children.title: Category Domain Model And Totals + Category Breakdown Web Summary
children.objective:
Extend Expense with an optional validated category field and add computeCategoryTotals with regression coverage for categorized and uncategorized expenses.
Render a category breakdown in the web summary surface while preserving existing balance presentation.
expectedOutcomes: src/domain/expense.ts defines the fixed category set and optional Expense category contract.
Invalid categories are rejected at the domain boundary used by existing expense validation or construction.
computeCategoryTotals returns totals grouped by category and handles missing categories according to the established domain convention.
tests/expense.test.ts covers valid categories, invalid categories, category totals, and unchanged balance behavior.
src/web/summary.ts includes category totals in the rendered summary output.
The existing balance summary remains present and semantically unchanged.
Tests verify category breakdown rendering alongside existing balance output.

children.title: Category Totals API
children.objective: Expose listCategoryTotals from the API layer using the domain category-total computation without changing existing balance APIs.
expectedOutcomes: listCategoryTotals delegates category grouping to computeCategoryTotals rather than duplicating domain logic.
API-level tests cover the new listCategoryTotals behavior and preserve existing balance API expectations.
